Hi Olga,

Hope you’re well — quick ask on behalf of CloudMarket and one of our SI partners (SI Integrations). We’re running a week-long SI-led bootcamp for a cohort of ~12 evaluation accounts (Quantify Labs and similar midsize finance/data analytics teams) the week of July 17. The partner has asked whether Redwood can endorse/allocate partner-sourced promotional credits to cover trial usage during the bootcamp.

High-level details:
- Cohort size: ~12 accounts (internal estimates)
- Expected peak nodes per account: 2 (short-lived for workshops)
- Typical session length: 2–4 hours per account; overall program 5 days
- Preferred activation window: July 10 — Aug 10 (30 days)

Can Redwood confirm whether this is eligible for a partner credit endorsement, and if so what constraints you need (per-account caps, activation window, contract language)? SI Integrations needs to confirm to their workshop customers this week.

I can share a brief deck and the bootcamp brief link if helpful: https://drive.company.com/bootcamp-brief

Thanks — appreciate a quick read and who I should loop on your side.

Best,

Looping in my approval — high level OK with partner-sourced credits for SI-led bootcamps when they meet a few guardrails. Conditional endorsement below:

Conditional approval (up to $15,000 total credits) subject to:
- Signed MCP addendum or equivalent (see attached draft_mcp_agreement.pdf). No credits released before signature.
- Per-account soft cap: $1,250 (we can reallocate if a subset underspends).
- Activation window limited to 30 days from provisioning. Single 14-day extension at Redwood discretion (no retroactive extensions).
- Credits are non-refundable and for onboarding/demo usage only (no long-term production workloads).
- Partner must provide per-account point-of-contact and complete the credit matrix with estimated spend.

Next steps (action items):
1) Partner completes bootcamp_credit_matrix.xlsx and returns to Partner Ops (Vanessa).
2) Legal signs MCP addendum (draft attached).
3) Partner Ops provisions voucher codes and returns activation_instructions.md to the partner with usage guardrails.

If Partner Ops confirms the matrix and legal signs by July 10 we can provision before the July 17 bootcamp.

Kimberly Park
